name: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC)
short_description: Cryptographic algorithms designed to resist attacks by quantum computers, such as the NIST-standardized lattice-based ML-KEM and ML-DSA and the hash-based SLH-DSA.

evidence.quote: the question won't be whether you need to migrate to post-quantum cryptography
NIST finalized the standards for post-quantum cryptography in August 2024
